top_news.title: Robust XGBoosting for Regression
top_news.dek: Researchers analyze the robustness of XGBoost against vertical outliers and leverage points in regression tasks.
top_news.brief: The study examines how standard XGBoost implementations perform under non-ideal data conditions. While quadratic loss is standard, the authors investigate the impact of outliers on model stability and performance, providing insights for more robust gradient boosting applications.

top_news.title: DeepSeek AI Releases DeepSeek Harness in Developer Preview: An MIT-Licensed Agent Harness Where Everything is a Plugin
top_news.dek: DeepSeek releases an MIT-licensed agent harness featuring a plugin-based architecture.
top_news.brief: DeepSeek Harness v0.1 is an MIT-licensed agent harness where every capability is a Cordis plugin. Four runtime modes, append-only session logs, and provider-agnostic model routing. The post DeepSeek AI Releases DeepSeek Harness in Developer Preview: An MIT-Licensed Agent Harness Where Everything is a Plugin appeared first on MarkTechPost.

top_news.title: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
top_news.dek: 404 Media tracked bulk shipments of rare books to an Amazon facility, suggesting large-scale physical scanning for AI model training.
top_news.brief: Reporters tracked anonymous, price-insensitive orders of rare books to an Amazon-linked location. This confirms ongoing industry practices of sourcing physical media to expand training datasets, mirroring previous reports of similar activities by companies like Anthropic.
top_news.image_alt: A stack of vintage books being prepared for shipment.

top_news.title: Show HN: Sokoban AI Solver
top_news.dek: A new web-based implementation of the classic Sokoban puzzle game features an integrated AI solver.
top_news.brief: The project provides a playable version of the 1980s warehouse-keeper puzzle where the player must push boxes onto goals. It includes an AI-driven solver to demonstrate pathfinding and state-space search techniques in a grid-based environment.
top_news.image_alt: A grid-based puzzle interface showing a warehouse keeper and boxes.

top_news.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
top_news.dek: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation to pivot from chip manufacturing to a neocloud infrastructure provider.
top_news.brief: The funding round, led by Disruptive with Nvidia participation, marks a significant shift for Groq. The company is moving away from its original AI chip hardware focus to prioritize GPU-powered cloud inference services, despite a lower valuation compared to its previous $6.9 billion peak.
top_news.image_alt: Abstract representation of cloud computing infrastructure.

primary.title: Does a Language Server Save Tokens for Coding Agents? A Measurement Methodology and Preliminary Study
